import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_name} - Invitation

{event_name}

{description_of_event}

Date: {date_of_event}

Notes: {notes_for_event}
""" def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Args: event_name: Title of the event. description_of_event: Detailed description (may contain newlines or formatting). date_of_event: Scheduled date string. notes_for_event: Additional instructions or notes. Returns: A string containing the HTML invitation with all user-provided content escaped to prevent XSS attacks (CWE-79). """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize HTML special characters. safe_event_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Format the template with sanitized values. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=safe_event_name, description_of_event=safe_description, date_of_event=safe_date, notes_for_event=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
